text:
maya: Quick heads up — planning to cut release/1.16 on Thu Mar 19 18:00 UTC. We need the release/* branch created 2 hours before cutoff, and backport rules signoff.

sanjay: I can create the branch. Which exact base? main at e8a9f3 or do we pin to release-candidate?

maya: Pin to main at HEAD (we need the latest infra fixes). Command we'll use:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.16 origin/main
git push origin release/1.16
```

jen: @sanjay can you also add the release-team write perms to the branch protection? I don't want CI to block pushes during the cut. :eyes: 

sanjay: Yep — will add a temporary exception for users in the 'release-team' org team. Will remove after the first stable roll.

liam: Quick backport policy question — do we allow PRs with doc-only changes to be backported automatically, or do they need manual approval?

maya: Docs-only can be cherry-picked by docs owners without additional approvals, but code changes require standard review + green CI. Documented in the RELEASE_PROCESS.md

release-bot: Reminder: cutoff window is 60 minutes. Any PRs merged to main after 17:00 UTC will not be eligible for 1.16 unless pre-approved by @maya or @jen. (automated)

jen: Can someone compile the initial cherry-pick list? I'll triage high-priority bugfixes. I can take ownership if no objections.

olga: I can do a pass on changelog entries today — please drop bullet points in #release-notes-queue.

sanjay: Branch created and pushed: release/1.16 -> https://git.internal/repo/+/refs/heads/release/1.16 :thumbsup:

maya: Awesome — thanks @sanjay. @liam please start the cherry-pick checklist; I'll open the cutout PR and tag QA for canary.

liam: On it. I'll post the checklist link once I have the first 5 PRs queued. ETA 45m.

maya: Perfect. If anything blocks perms/CI ping me directly. :pray:
